messages.subject: Instructions to advise — Brightwater v Caldervale
messages.plaintextBody:
Harriet,

Instructions to advise on merits and quantum to follow by courier. Headline: wrongful termination of a 3-year SaaS contract; unpaid £90k milestone plus c.£840k lost licence (pre-credit). Two strong points — Schedule 4 methodology and absence of any clause 16.3 notice. We'd also value your steer on a sensible first offer before the CMC.

Tom

messages.subject: RE: Instructions to advise — Brightwater v Caldervale
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Advice attached. In short I put prospects on liability at 70–75%, net principal c.£804,000 after the 15% avoided-cost credit, plus interest. The 14 June SSO point and the missing clause 16.3 notice are both strong. On settlement, a first offer around £585,000 inclusive of interest, costs each side, is well-judged and defensible as Part 36/Calderbank.

I've also marked up the draft Particulars — interest rate and the Schedule 4 exclusion wording. Redline to follow separately.

Harriet Stanford
Eldon Chambers
